title: Step 4c - Comparing Training vs Test Set Predictions in Linear Regression

cues.en: Instructor: All right, so that's the results of the training set.
cues.zh: 這就是訓練集的結果。

cues.en: These are quite good results, but that's because we trained our linear regression models on the training set.
cues.zh: 表現相當不錯，但那是因為線性迴歸就是用訓練集建立的。

cues.en: And now let's see how our simple linear regression model can predict new observations, that is, new observations of the test set.
cues.zh: 現在看看模型對新觀測值，也就是測試集的預測能力。

cues.en: So I'm gonna close that.
cues.zh: 先關閉這裡。

cues.en: And now let's do the same for the test sets to see if our simple linear regression can make some good predictions on new observations.
cues.zh: 對測試集做同樣的事，看看它是否能對新觀測值做出好預測。

cues.en: So the test set observations on which our model wasn't built.
cues.zh: 這些測試資料沒有用來建立模型。

cues.en: So as usual, we want to be efficient, and so we're going to copy all this, copy and paste it here.
cues.zh: 照慣例，要有效率，所以把整段複製，貼到這裡。

cues.en: So let's replace all the training set here by test set.
cues.zh: 把這裡的 Training set 換成 Test set。

cues.en: Okay, here as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣。

cues.en: Training set, test set.
cues.zh: Training set，改成 Test set。

cues.en: That's the test set results.
cues.zh: 這就是測試集結果。

cues.en: Okay, so now we must be careful with something.
cues.zh: 但有一件事要小心。

cues.en: Let's see if we have to replace all the training sets.
cues.zh: 是不是所有 training_set 都要換？

cues.en: So in the first component of ggplot() that is when we plot all the observation points, the real observations here, we have training_set$YearsExperience and training_set$Salary.
cues.zh: ggplot 的第一個元件畫真實觀測點，這裡目前是 training_set$YearsExperience 與 training_set$Salary。

cues.en: In your opinion, do we need to change training set here by Test set?
cues.zh: 你認為這裡要換成 test_set 嗎？

cues.en: Yes, of course, because this time we want to have the observation points of the test set.
cues.zh: 當然，因為這次要畫測試集觀測點。

cues.en: So we want to take the year's experience here of the test set observations and the salaries of the test set observations.
cues.zh: 所以要取測試集觀測值的年資，以及測試集的薪資。

cues.en: And here we will replace training set by test set.
cues.zh: 因此這裡換成 test_set。

cues.en: Okay, but now in geom_line, so that is the component that builds a regression line.
cues.zh: 但 geom_line，也就是建立迴歸線的元件，

cues.en: Do we need to replace training sets by test set here?
cues.zh: 這裡需要換成 test_set 嗎？

cues.en: You know, training set here and training set here?
cues.zh: 也就是這兩個 training_set。

cues.en: Do we need to replace those two training sets by test set?
cues.zh: 要把它們都換掉嗎？

cues.en: Well, the answer is actually of course, no, because our regressor is already trained on the training set.
cues.zh: 答案是不需要，因為 regressor 已在訓練集上訓練完成。

cues.en: So whether we keep here the training set or replace by test set, we will obtain the same simple linear regression line.
cues.zh: 不論保留 training_set，或換成 test_set，都會得到同一條簡單線性迴歸線。

cues.en: Indeed, if we replaced here training set by test set, we would just build some new points of the same regression line corresponding to the new predictions of the test set observation points,
cues.zh: 如果改用 test_set，只是算出同一條迴歸線上，對應測試集新預測的那些點。

cues.en: because when we trained our simple linear regressor on the training set, we obtained one unique model equation which is the simple linear equation itself.
cues.zh: 因為在訓練集上訓練完成後，就已得到唯一的一個模型方程式，也就是簡單線性方程式。

cues.en: And therefore whether we build the regression line here by predicting the training set points or the test set points, well, since this predictions result from the same unique simple linear equation,
cues.zh: 因此，不論用訓練集還是測試集的預測來畫線，既然都來自同一個方程式，

cues.en: we will get the same regression line.
cues.zh: 最後就會得到相同的迴歸線。

cues.en: Okay, now, so that means that now we're ready.
cues.zh: 所以現在準備好了。

cues.en: Okay, test set, test set, test set here, and training set here.
cues.zh: 這裡、這裡、這裡是 test_set，這裡仍是 training_set。

cues.en: We're all good.
cues.zh: 都正確。

cues.en: We are ready to plot the test set results to find out how our simple linear regression behaves on new observations.
cues.zh: 準備畫測試集結果，看看模型對新觀測值的表現。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Press Command and Control plus Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So as you can see, as I was telling you, if we go back to the training set here, you can see that only the red points change, you see, and the blue regression line doesn't change.
cues.zh: 如前所述，切回訓練集比較，可以看到只有紅點改變，藍色迴歸線沒有變。

cues.en: You see it's the same here, only the red points change.
cues.zh: 這裡也是同一條線，只有紅點不同。

cues.en: So here that's the training set observation points with the model built on the training set.
cues.zh: 這張是訓練集觀測點，以及用訓練集建立的模型。

cues.en: And here that's the test set observations with the same regression line built on the training set.
cues.zh: 這張是測試集觀測值，搭配同樣由訓練集建立的迴歸線。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's zoom on the test set plot and give some interpretation.
cues.zh: 放大測試集圖表，解讀一下。

cues.en: Okay, so the test set results are actually not bad.
cues.zh: 測試集結果其實不錯。

cues.en: We can see that we have some very good predictions here for example, for this employee, this employee this employee, and this one as well, because as you can see,
cues.zh: 這裡有幾個預測很好，例如這位員工、這位、這位，還有這一位，因為

cues.en: the real value is closed to the prediction which is on the blue regression line.
cues.zh: 實際值都很接近藍色迴歸線上的預測值。

cues.en: So since these are new observations on which our simple linear narrow regression model didn't learn any correlation, that's actually quite a good job to find predictions
cues.zh: 這些是模型從未用來學習關係的新觀測值，能預測得

cues.en: so close to the real value.
cues.zh: 如此接近實際值，已經做得相當好。

cues.en: And of course there are some predictions that are further from the real value, but that's because there is not a hundred percent linear dependency between the salary and the years of experience.
cues.zh: 當然，有些預測離實際值較遠，因為薪資與年資並非百分之百線性相依。

cues.en: But for sure there is a certain linear dependency.
cues.zh: 但兩者確實存在一定的線性關係。

cues.en: Alright, so thank you for watching this tutorials about simple linear regression.
cues.zh: 謝謝觀看這幾堂簡單線性迴歸教學。

cues.en: In the next section we'll find out about a new type of linear regression which is gonna be the multiple linear regression, meaning that instead of having only one independent variable,
cues.zh: 下一章要介紹新的線性迴歸類型，也就是多元線性迴歸，不再只有一個自變數，

cues.en: we'll have several independent variables that will predict a single dependent variable.
cues.zh: 而是用多個自變數，預測單一依變數。

cues.en: So there will be a new business problem and I can't wait to solve it with you using multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 會有新的商業問題，我很期待和你用多元線性迴歸一起解決。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一章見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
